plugins.name: neuro-matrix
plugins.description: Anti-neuroslop harness: agents (developer/analyzer/critic/epistemic-auditor) + hooks (cycle/approval/verification gates) + invariants. mirabilis appends the plugin's CLAUDE.md to Claude's system prompt at launch (--append-system-prompt-file); the plugin's SessionStart hook only runs an MCP health check.
